description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Individual federal grant payment disbursements (which organizations received grant funds and when) from public payment reports, including the recipient's own justification text. Filter by agency, recipient organization, keyword, or FAIN. These are disbursements made, not cancellations; the feed is historical (stopped meaningful updates around October 2025). Present as information only. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
